objective: Remove repeated combat and non-combat grid packing during held-action strip motion and preserve the final adjacent border contacts.
changes: Remember per-grid packing inputs and requested public geometry after a successful regular layout.
Verify the current shared squeeze, native slot/frame geometry and button ownership before retaining a grid on a held-action crossing.
Keep layout on slot changes, binding mode, deferred/batched work and explicit calls. Always request Info/envelope completion so translations are visible before junction commit.

replay.scope: Actual Lua packers, strip-dependent dispatch and Info/envelope completion using modeled widgets, root translations, and face paint. Work counts exclude other HUD owners and do not establish FPS, taint or live pixels.
guards: changed squeeze, grouped order, spacing, visibility and occupancy
changed frame level, native size, point and button widget repair
private or unavailable values restore original writer
reentrant order mutation invalidates packing cache
binding override and explicit layout keep full pass
batched or combat work released by existing guard paths
